items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Well, yeah, that's why I just called it Dubin. Dubin. A little place they called back there. Dubin.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, that's why I just called it Dubin.

Dubin. A little place they called back there. Dubin. Dubin, yeah. But I lived back there a while. I was sick and came over here. I've been over here ever since. I come from Bellashad. Bellashad, that's my home. I came from Bellashad when I was a little years old. You were going there and there. Yeah, going to Bellashad.
